provenance_rule: Derived divided differences from one source series remain one provenance family and are not independent evidence.
authority_rule: RDDO telemetry may veto or raise verification burden but cannot grant canonical promotion, RealityValidated, Ascension, or real-world actuation.
deployment_rule: Repository presence alone does not establish host deployment; exact source SHA, successful local compile/self-test, state attestation, and fresh runtime compatibility evidence are required.
